title: Inspect and extend: Make offline mode explicit and reject placeholders
objective: Use the real implementation in `src/chat.ts` to demonstrate and safely improve expo_public_chat_url, secure websocket validation, `.example` rejection, idle status.
problem: Offline mode should not accidentally dial a fake host. Trace endpoint validation and the early return in connect; then distinguish the seeded local UI from a live server session. Your implementation or debugging result must remain consistent with the source architecture.
requirements: Read `src/chat.ts` and the related project files: src/chat.ts; src/chatContext.tsx; test/chat.test.ts.
Add or improve a focused behavior related to expo_public_chat_url, secure websocket validation, `.example` rejection, idle status.
Add a meaningful unit test or, when platform tooling is unavailable, document a reproducible manual check.
Update documentation to identify local, simulated, external, and missing behavior accurately.
constraints: Do not claim or implement as complete a capability outside this boundary: Only a compatible real wss endpoint should be configured; no server was tested here.
Do not add credentials, personal records, real funds, or unsafe public network exposure.
Keep the change within the existing project architecture and name any new dependencies.
expected_behavior: Offline mode should not accidentally dial a fake host. Trace endpoint validation and the early return in connect; then distinguish the seeded local UI from a live server session.
acceptance_criteria: The implementation change is traceable to `src/chat.ts`.
Normal and failure/edge cases are described and tested.
The test outcome and environment are recorded honestly.
README or source comments correctly state remaining limitations.
hints: Read the caller and the closest existing test before editing.
Separate a pure rule test from any UI, device, provider, or network test.
